name: gptvis-tanstack-charts-workspace
description: Monorepo for the GPT-Vis TanStack Charts adapter and its playground.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w gptvis-tanstack-charts && npm run dev -w playground
scripts.build: npm run build -w gptvis-tanstack-charts && npm run build -w playground
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w gptvis-tanstack-charts && npm run build -w gptvis-tanstack-charts && npm run typecheck -w playground
